subject: MediSys — private deployment integration readout / architecture deep-dive
messages:
From: Ryan Gomez <ryan.gomez@medisys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — architecture deep-dive request

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Wed like to schedule a technical readout to walk through our VPC/on-prem requirements and confirm the integration points for an air-gapped install. Key agenda items: network egress constraints, KMS/HSM integration, and access patterns for the Redwood serving runtime.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu 9/9 09:00–10:00
- Thu 9/9 13:00–14:00
- Fri 9/10 08:00–09:00

Attendees from MediSys: myself (platform lead), Anika Patel (security engineer), and our infra lead (TBD). Can you confirm which slot works and whether your team needs anything pre-populated (topology, firewall rules)?

Also attaching a short PDF with our high-level constraints (attached: medisys-precall-checklist.pdf).

Thanks — Ryan

--
Ryan Gomez
Platform Engineering, MediSys Health
ryan.gomez@medisys.com
+1 (512) 555-0189
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Gomez <ryan.gomez@medisys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — architecture deep-dive request

Ryan — thanks for the summary and the checklist. This is exactly the right level of detail. We can cover all those agenda items.

I can take the 9/9 13:00–14:00 PDT slot. Karthik will drive the runtime/kernel selection and Jonas will cover private deployment ops and can speak to air-gap packaging.

Prep items for the call (well try to fill these ahead of time):
- Network CIDR ranges and whether outbound egress is allowed to specific Redwood endpoints (yes/no)
- KMS/HSM vendor and access model (certs, proxies)
- Approximate qps / peak concurrency we should target

Im attaching a simple network topology template you can drop values into: network-topology-template.xlsx. If you can populate that before the meeting it will shorten the deep-dive.

Ill send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Best,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Gomez <ryan.gomez@medisys.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — architecture deep-dive request

Ryan / Anika — quick note on sizing and data flow so we can be prepared:
- Can you confirm expected steady-state token throughput (tokens/sec) and average request size? If you dont have tokens, QPS and average payload size is fine.
- Will model artifacts be pulled from a private S3 or delivered via an air-gapped bundle? If private S3, does it sit in the same VPC?

Timezone note: Im in PDT but our infra lead will join from EST — the 13:00 PDT slot is OK for us.

Also: for the call please include any PCI/HIPAA contact if you have one — it will help speed the KMS discussion.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Anika Patel <anika.patel@medisys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Gomez <ryan.gomez@medisys.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — architecture deep-dive request

Thanks — quick heads up: our CTO just asked me to move the 9/9 13:00 slot to 9/10 morning because of an exec meeting that ran longer than expected. Is there any availability on 9/10 between 08:00–11:00 PDT?

Apologies for the churn — well aim to have the topology template filled out by EOD today.

On the KMS side: were evaluating Luna HSM and HashiCorp Vault (Transit). We can describe both options on the call.

–Anika

To: Anika Patel <anika.patel@medisys.com>, Ryan Gomez <ryan.gomez@medisys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — architecture deep-dive request

Anika / Ryan — 9/10 at 08:30–09:30 PDT works for our team. Ive created a calendar event and included the meeting link here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-medisys-arch.

Agenda (30–45 minute deep-dive):
1) Quick intros and scope (5 mins)
2) Network & egress constraints (10 mins)
3) KMS/HSM approach & authentication (10 mins)
4) Packaging options for air-gapped installs and transfer mechanics (10 mins)
5) Action items & follow-ups (5 mins)

Please attach the completed topology template to the event or drop it in the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X_example_drive_folder.

We will also bring a short runbook for the private-deploy install and a checklist of firewall domains/ports. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Irene

Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
